billingCycle.description: monthly, yearly, or lifetime. Null on free plans.

alias.description: Custom slug (letters/numbers/hyphens/underscores): 5-50 chars on u2l.ai and u.gy, 1-50 chars on your own custom domains and subdomains. Random when omitted.

appFallback.description: App deep links (Advanced+): 'store' sends mobile visitors without the domain's app installed to the App Store / Play Store (with the link carried in the Play install referrer). Requires a mobile app configured on the link's domain in the dashboard; visitors with the app installed open it directly via the domain's universal/app links.

cloaking.description: URL cloaking (Advanced+): serve the destination inside a frame so visitors keep seeing the short URL.

deepLink.description: Open the destination in its native mobile app (YouTube, Instagram, etc.) when the visitor has it installed. Works with supported apps only - other destinations return 400.

domain.description: `auto` (default) picks the best domain for the destination. Or pass one of your domains from List domains.

expiredUrl.description: Where visitors are redirected (302) once the link has expired by date or click limit. Unset shows the standard expired page.

externalBrowser.description: Open in External Browser (Pro+): open the link in the visitor's default browser (Safari or Chrome) when it is tapped inside an in-app browser such as Instagram, TikTok or Facebook. Works with any destination and can be on together with deepLink.

maxClicks.description: Expire the link after this many human clicks (Growth+). Enforcement is eventual: the link stops within a few minutes of the limit; bot traffic never counts.

password.description: Password-protect the link (Advanced plan or above).

pixels.description: Retargeting pixels (Advanced+). Fired from a brief redirect page for human visitors only.

startsAt.description: Before this time the link serves a not-active-yet page. Must be before expiresAt when both are set.

url.description: Destination URL. `https://` is assumed if no scheme is given.

notice.description: Human-readable explanation of the domain choice.

noticeCode.description: Present when the domain differs from the one requested (trust-based placement).

events.description: Events to subscribe to. Defaults to all.

url.description: HTTPS URL that receives event POSTs.

secret.description: Signing secret (u2lwh_...). Shown only in this response - store it now. Used to verify the X-U2L-Signature header.

CustomOg.description: Custom social preview (Advanced plan or above).

type.description: `default` is the automatic choice; `trust-based` (u2l.ai) accepts trusted destinations only.

appFallback.description: App deep links (Advanced+): 'store' sends mobile visitors without the domain's app installed to the App Store / Play Store (with the link carried in the Play install referrer). Requires a mobile app configured on the link's domain in the dashboard; visitors with the app installed open it directly via the domain's universal/app links.

clickCount.description: Human clicks counted toward maxClicks. Present only when maxClicks is set.

cloaking.description: URL cloaking (Advanced+): serve the destination inside a frame so visitors keep seeing the short URL.

deepLink.description: Open the destination in its native mobile app (YouTube, Instagram, etc.) when the visitor has it installed. Works with supported apps only - other destinations return 400.

expiredUrl.description: Where visitors are redirected (302) once the link has expired by date or click limit. Unset shows the standard expired page.

externalBrowser.description: Open in External Browser (Pro+): open the link in the visitor's default browser (Safari or Chrome) when it is tapped inside an in-app browser such as Instagram, TikTok or Facebook. Works with any destination and can be on together with deepLink.

maxClicks.description: Expire the link after this many human clicks (Growth+). Enforcement is eventual: the link stops within a few minutes of the limit; bot traffic never counts.

pixels.description: Retargeting pixels (Advanced+). Fired from a brief redirect page for human visitors only.

startsAt.description: Before this time the link serves a not-active-yet page. Must be before expiresAt when both are set.

type.description: SL = short link, QR = QR code, PG = link-in-bio page.

devices.description: Clicks per device type (mobile / desktop / tablet).

timeRange.description: The requested range in days (0 = all time).

Pixel.description: A retargeting pixel fired from the redirect page for human visitors (crawlers never trigger pixels).

event.description: Meta only. PageView is always sent. The event you choose is sent as well when someone opens this link, before the redirect. It does not confirm an action on the destination. Omit for other providers. Use one event selection per pixel ID.

id.description: Vendor pixel/container/tag ID, e.g. a Meta Pixel ID. Google Tag Manager IDs must look like GTM-ABC123 and Google Ads tag IDs like AW-123456789. Links with a gtm pixel are created on u.gy (or your custom domain); a u2l.ai link cannot gain one on edit.

QrStyle.description: QR styling (QR links only; pattern/logo customization requires Pro plan or above).

Rotation.description: N-way weighted rotation (Advanced+). Visitors are split randomly across 2-10 target URLs by integer weights summing to 100. Supersedes the legacy abTest fields when set; analytics reports variants as A, B, C... by target order.

RoutingRules.description: Traffic routing rules (Advanced+). Matched visitors are redirected to the rule URL instead of the base destination; rules override the A/B pick.

browser.description: Browser mapped to a URL. Keys: `chrome`, `safari`, `firefox`, `edge`, `opera`, `samsung`, `yandex`. Beats language and location rules; device rules beat it.

city.description: Lowercase "city|cc" key (e.g. "bengaluru|in") mapped to a URL. Most specific; IP city detection is best-effort. Max 20 rules.

continent.description: Continent code (AF, AN, AS, EU, NA, OC, SA) mapped to a URL. A country rule beats a continent rule.

device.description: Device type mapped to a destination URL. Keys: `ios`, `android`, `mobile`, `windows`, `macos`, `chromeos`, `linux`, `desktop`. A specific OS beats its generic bucket (`mobile` for phones, `desktop` for computers).

geo.description: Uppercase ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (or `default`) mapped to a destination URL. Max 20 rules.

language.description: Lowercase ISO 639 language code (e.g. `es`) mapped to a URL, matched against the visitor's primary browser language. Beats location rules; device rules beat it. Max 20 rules.

region.description: Lowercase "region|cc" key using the region name (e.g. "karnataka|in") or the ISO 3166-2 code (e.g. "ka|in") mapped to a URL. Beats country rules. Max 20 rules.

time.description: Day, hour and date rules read in one time zone. The first matching rule wins; time rules beat every rule except `utm`. Max 20 rules.

days.description: Days of the week, 0 = Sunday ... 6 = Saturday. Omit for every day.

from.description: Start time HH:MM (with `to`). A window where `from` is later than `to` runs past midnight.

visitorZone.description: Read the clock in each visitor's own time zone instead (falls back to `zone` when unknown).

zone.description: IANA time zone the rules are read in, e.g. `Asia/Kolkata`.

utm.description: `utm_param=value` key mapped to a URL, matched against UTM parameters on the short link itself (`utm_source`, `utm_medium`, `utm_campaign`, `utm_term`, `utm_content`, checked in that order; values compare case-insensitively). Beats every other rule. Max 20 rules.

active.description: Re-enabling a disabled endpoint resets its failure count.

failureCount.description: Consecutive failed deliveries. The endpoint is disabled automatically at 20. Resets to 0 on any successful delivery.

bearerAuth.description: API key from the U2L dashboard (Settings > API). Format: `u2l_live_` followed by 32 hex characters.

info.description: The U2L public REST API. Create and manage short links and QR codes, organize them into folders, and read click analytics programmatically. All endpoints are authenticated with a Bearer API key (`u2l_live_...`) created in the U2L dashboard under Settings > API. API access is available on every plan; request rates and creation velocity are limited per plan.

post.description: Creates a short link or QR code. By default the domain is chosen automatically: destinations recognized as trusted land on `u2l.ai`, everything else on `u.gy` - this never errors. Pass a specific `domain` to use one of your subdomains or verified custom domains instead.

error.message: Alias "my-link" is already taken on u.gy.

409.description: The requested alias is already taken or reserved.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a link. The short URL stops resolving immediately. This cannot be undone.

get.description: Returns a single link, including its total click count.

patch.description: Updates a link. Only the fields you send are changed. Send `password: null` to remove a password; send `expiresAt: null` to remove expiration. Destination changes on `u2l.ai` links re-run the trust check - untrusted destinations are rejected (move the link to another domain instead).

get.description: Account-wide totals: links, QR codes, all-time clicks, this week's clicks, plus your plan limits.
List all webhook endpoints on your account. The signing secret is never returned after creation.

post.description: Register an HTTPS endpoint to receive link events. Requires the Pro plan or above; each plan has a maximum number of endpoints (Pro 3, Growth 5, Advanced 10, Team 20, Enterprise 50). The response includes the signing secret exactly once.

delete.description: Remove a webhook endpoint. Pending deliveries to it are dropped.

patch.description: Change the URL, subscribed events, or active state. Setting active to true on a disabled endpoint resets its failure count.
